programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2026
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational by The North Face 2026 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.title: Climbing Skye s Highest Peak - Sgurr Alasdair
programme.desc: Cris and Viv decided to climb Sgurr Alasdair, the highest mountain on the island of Skye, located in an area of the mountain range known as Black Cullin. The main challenge they had in climbing the peak was the Great Stone Chute. A 300-meter slope of the harshest mountain terrain - scree. The summit of Sgurr Alasdair has unobstructed views of all of the Munroes in the Black Cullin, and also of one of Skyes most famous routes - The Cullin Ridge traverse.

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: The Rise of the Hamminator Lindsey Hamm s journey from concrete to peaks
programme.desc: Mammut athlete Lindsey Hamm, a professional climber and mountain guide, brings a breath of fresh air to the world of mountaineering. Originally from Texas, she has begun making a name for herself in recent years. This short film offers a glimpse into her life, a recent expedition to Pakistan’s wild Charakusa Valley. Beyond the mountains, Lindsey is a people person, driven by a passion for inclusivity in climbing, and giving opportunities to other women, who want to get into the sport. She collaborates with womens organizations in Pakistan, helping to dismantle barriers and create opportunities for education and growth.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Lekkarod 2025
programme.desc: Depuis 10 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 10 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata in the Julian Alps Eng
programme.desc: Just about an hours drive from Ljubljana airport, Prisojnik, or Prisank as its also called is a beautiful 2,547m mountain in Slovenias Julian Alps.This one-day via Ferrata route is a must-do since it presents an excellent hiking and climbing challenge, but also offers all of the views youd even want. To get to its summit Cris and Viv hiked, scrambled, climbed, and even crawled on their stomachs at points, but the views in the end and the feeling of satisfaction that came after made it all worthwhile.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng
programme.desc: Mount Sneffels is a prominent mountain near Ouray, Colorado in the United States which is over 14,000 feet high, more than 4,300 metres. Audree had never climbed a 14er, so we decided to try reach its summit while on a road trip through Colorado in late-July.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: Florence Marathon - We run in art Eng
programme.desc: two select runners comment on their participation in the Florence marathon and the organizers provide unique insights on the Florence marathon.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: Ultra Gobi 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Each year, athletes from across the world gather in this remote wilderness og the Gobi desert for a test like no other. The 121-kilometer team challenge is where cooperation and strategy are everything, while the 121-kilometere solo adventure is a test for the braves. The legendary 400-kilometer race, a journey through solitude, extremes, and self-discovery. All together, they form one of the toughest endurance events on Earth.

programme.title: Challenge Family 2025 - Season Wrap Up Eng
programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. Known for its unique courses, passionate community, and athlete-centered values, Challenge Family offers races in some of the world’s most iconic locations. From the breathtaking landscapes to the demands of each event, Challenge Family is about more than just competition. It’s about athletes pushing beyond their limits, fueled by the support of fans, family, and each other. Through the journeys of athletes, everyone can understand what it takes to prepare, to overcome, and to race with a purpose that goes far beyond the finish line.

programme.title: X-out Montenegro Eng
programme.desc: X-out Montenegro is part of the Xtri World Tour. Athletes starts with a 1.7 km open-water course. The race is started by the Xekutioner, a formidable figure who will be responsible for future eliminations. 15 of athletes will be eliminated by the Xekutioner, intensifying the competition. Eliminated athletes are given a time penatly and can then try to catch “The Splitter” to ovetake backmarkers and get back in the race! Then a tough and demanding 40 km asphalt cycle which climbs the famous serpentine above Kotor. Designed to test endurance to the max. Another 15 of athletes are eliminated by the Xekutioner here, ensuring only the toughest stay. Finally 6.5 km of downhill trail running and 2.5 km of “vertical” monster climbing. Again eliminated athletes have the opportunity to catch the leaders.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca Camí de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. programme.title: UTMB KODIAK Ultra Marathon 2025
programme.desc: Two distances. One adventure. Feel the grit of the 50K, the madness of the 100K, and the shared passion that drives every runner forward. Dive into 45 minutes of raw trail energy. Relive the HOKA Kodiak Ultramarathons as if you were there.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race — it’s a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling — every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection — with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards

programme.desc: The HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB is the final of four UTMB World Series majors in 2025, offering athletes a great opportunity to progress towards the UTMB World Series Finals. Celebrating its 6th edition with new and improved courses along with an even deeper connection to Thailands natural and cultural heritage, the event attracts over 7,200 participants, including 56 from the Asia region and an exceptional elite field across all distances.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1
programme.desc: Jonathan keert terug naar India voor een speciale aflevering waarin hij zijn enorme archief van ervaringen door het hele land verkent. Ook geeft hij een exclusief kijkje achter de schermen en onthult hij hoe de show in elkaar wordt gezet.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan trapt het seizoen af met een verkenning van Nederlandse curiositeiten en stapt vervolgens aan boord van ’s werelds grootste vrachtschip, op weg naar Marokko, waar een geheel nieuw avontuur begint.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Josh verkent de buurt in Armenië en de hoofdstad Yerevan, bezoekt enkele verlaten Sovjet gebouwen, een breifabriek en een luxe hotel.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Josh is terug in Gary, Indiana, voor een lokale verkenningstocht. Samen met vrienden bezoekt hij een voormalige bank, het gedenkauditorium en treinstation Union.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash is aangekomen in Peking, waar hij Terry Townsend ontmoet om meer te leren over natuurbescherming in de regio rond de Chinese Muur. Ook ontmoet hij twee andere Muurbeschermers en proeft hij lokale lekkernijen in het dorp Shi Xia.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S1
programme.desc: Na een demonstratie van gastjurylid Gareth Stewart proberen de teams een perfecte ossenhaas te bereiden. De laatste Throwdown-uitdaging vraagt hen om een feestmaal met zeevruchten – kaimoana – te maken. Wie bereikt de finale?

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S1
programme.desc: De twee finalisten nemen het tegen elkaar op in een zinderend gevecht vol barbecuevaardigheden. Eerst bereiden ze een banket op een houtvuur. Daarna volgt de klassieke BBQ-uitdaging met brisket, spareribs en kip – allemaal beoordeeld in een blindproeverij.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: Zes teams ontmoeten presentator Ganesh Raj en BBQ-experts Jared Macdonald en Jess Pryles in Waiamuku om te beginnen aan de ultieme barbecuestrijd. Ze worden uitgedaagd om twee gerechten te maken die hun barbecuekwaliteiten laten zien: een low 'n slow en een hot 'n fast.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Op weg naar het uiterste noorden, naar de Arctis, om de traditionele cultuur en het indrukwekkende leven van de Inuit te ontdekken, vergezellen de broers een oudere en een jonge jager op een 200 mijl lange sneeuwscootertocht over het barre land en bevroren zee-ijs.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: De broers doorkruisen het onderling verbonden netwerk van waterwegen per veerboot. Van een garnalenbaron tot eenvoudige vissers, van eeuwenoude tempelruïnes tot anonieme chai wallahs – ze banen zich een weg naar Kushtia, de thuisbasis van het heiligdom van Guru Lalone Shaw.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: Met speciale visa op zak regelen de broers 10 pony’s en 6 dragers en beginnen ze aan een adembenemende, maar zware 13-daagse ponytocht over de Himalaya naar de Mustang-vallei, waar ze hopen een ontmoeting met de koning te regelen.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Mumbai’s opkomst van armoede naar rijkdom wordt in al zijn facetten ervaren: Bollywoodrollen, een verblijf in het Taj Palace en een diepgaande tour door de Dharavi-sloppenwijken – oh, en vergeet de rattenjacht niet!

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Muay Thai, rivierfestivals, toeristenscams en olifantenmenners! Dit is Thailand, bekeken op de Road Less Traveled-manier.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan verkent de uiterste randen van Indonesië: zwarte magiërs, semi-actieve vulkanen en zwavelspuwende meren!

programme.title: Roads End S1
programme.desc: Het duo staat een dag van druiven plukken te wachten en ze ontdekken een nieuwe liefde voor de grootste export van het land.

programme.title: Roads End S1
programme.sub-title: Back to where it all started
programme.desc: In deze aflevering bereiken Rob en Dave het einde van hun ongelofelijke reis en moeten teruggaan naar waar het ooit allemaal begon, in Buenos Aires.

programme.title: Roads End S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering proosten Rob en Dave op hun recentelijk afgelegde trip door Argentinië.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: In Epic Exploring: Going Local wordt Zagreb, Kroatië bezocht. Cody vuurt een kanon af in de oude toren, verkent een nooit afgebouwd universiteitsziekenhuis en een politiekschool.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Local Exploring gaat naar de uithoeken van de wereld, waarbij Josh naar pooleiland Svalbard gaat om de buurt van Barentsburg en de Arctische Oceaan te bezoeken.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Vanuit Tirana, de hoofdstad van oud Sovjetsatellieteiland Albanië, begint Josh weer een avontuur door de buurt en bezoekt bunkers en een verborgen ziekenhuis en hij duikt in een piratengrot.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: De vijf terugkerende teams gaan terug naar de basis en bereiden gevogelte op klassieke ketelbarbecues. Net als ze denken dat ze alles onder controle hebben, krijgen ze een verrassende wending van de jury.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: De overgebleven vier teams worden opgesplitst in twee groepen voor een teamuitdaging op twee 500-gallon offset smokers. Gastjurylid Gareth Stewart daagt de verliezende teams uit om een restaurantwaardig hertengerecht na te maken in de eerste Scorcher-uitdaging.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: Een verrassing uit het verleden introduceert een nieuw team in de competitie. De teams bereiden een Aziatisch streetfoodfestijn op hibachi-grills, waarna twee teams in de Scorcher-uitdaging een klassieke Franse tarte tatin moeten maken.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: In een bushplane vliegen de broers naar het uiterste punt van ‘The Rock’ en keren ze terug naar het ruige, afgelegen eiland waar ze zijn geboren. Per kajak peddelen ze van visserijhaven naar visserijhaven, totdat ze hun ultieme bestemming bereiken.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan laat zien waarom zijn thuisstaat de ultieme bestemming is voor buitenactiviteiten: trackdays, paragliden en zwemmen. De reis begint in San Francisco en slingert helemaal naar het zuiden, tot aan Los Angeles.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Terug in Azië begint Jonathan aan een wandeltocht om alle verborgen kanten van Manila te ontdekken – een tocht die eindigt met een ontmoeting met niemand minder dan Manny Pacquiao!

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan speurt naar gevallen van mystiek en lokale folklore. Als tegenhanger van het macabere besluit hij zijn eigen schoonheidswedstrijd te organiseren in de stad Iloilo.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: In zijn zwaarste uitdaging tot nu toe waagt Ash zich aan Eagle’s Neck – een berucht steil en gevaarlijk stuk van de Chinese Muur. Maar eerst ontmoet hij technologie-experts die helpen de Muur digitaal in kaart te brengen, met als doel haar te beschermen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Langs het westelijke deel van de Muur reist Ash naar Binnen-Mongolië om daar een nomadenfamilie te ontmoeten en zich te wagen aan Mongoolse worsteltechnieken. Hij hoopt het Naadam-festival bij te wonen, waar paardrijden – een belangrijk onderdeel van de Mongoolse cultuur – centraal staat.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Epic Exploring verkent de buurt weer en Cody gaat naar Lüderitz, Namibië, en verlaat daat de gebaande paden, helemaal door de woestijn heen, om naar spookstad Pamona te gaan.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Local Exploring in Tokio is compleet anders dan anders. Josh en Lexi Limitless bezoeken de drukke straten, een schreeuwend Monster Café en een verlaten 'liefdeshotel'.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: Vier teams nemen het tegen elkaar op in de halve finale. Eerst bereiden ze een zeevruchtenfestijn om indruk te maken op de beroemde chef Tom Hishon (Kingi, Orphans Kitchen, Daily Bread). Daarna koken de twee laagst scorende teams om hun plek in de finale te veroveren in de ultieme test van eenvoud: het perfecte stuk steak voor een verrassingsjurylid. Wie haalt de finale?

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: Vier teams nemen het tegen elkaar op in de halve finale. Eerst bereiden ze een zeevruchtenfestijn om indruk te maken op de beroemde chef Tom Hishon (Kingi, Orphans Kitchen, Daily Bread). Daarna koken de twee laagst scorende teams om hun plek in de finale te veroveren in de ultieme test van eenvoud: het perfecte stuk steak voor een verrassingsjurylid. Wie haalt de finale?

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: De drie finalisten strijden in twee rondes. Eerst een live fire-uitdaging waarbij ze een volledig lam Asado-stijl moeten bereiden, gevolgd door een barbecue-degustatie om indruk te maken op de legendarische chef-kok Al Brown.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2
programme.desc: De drie finalisten strijden in twee rondes. Eerst een live fire-uitdaging waarbij ze een volledig lam Asado-stijl moeten bereiden, gevolgd door een barbecue-degustatie om indruk te maken op de legendarische chef-kok Al Brown.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1
programme.desc: De broers liften vanuit de oude Inca-hoofdstad Cuzco langs de ruggengraat van de Andes naar het Titicacameer. Ze krijgen te maken met ernstige hoogteziekte, kauwen op cocabladeren om op krachten te blijven en ontmoeten lokale bewoners terwijl ze zich een weg banen door het Andesgebergte.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash trekt de woestijn in om Wu Xinlei te ontmoeten, een survival-expert. Hij wil begrijpen hoe het voor de mensen moet zijn geweest die de Chinese Muur in dit afgelegen en onverbiddelijke landschap bouwden.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan stuit op een marketingcampagne rondom shoe-dating en gaat op drie unieke dates om Kuala Lumpur te verkennen. Later komt hij diep in Sarawak in een onverwachte situatie terecht.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan stuitert als een flipperkastbal door Hanoi, verkent eeuwenoude fabels, proeft exotische gerechten en helpt MAG International bij het verwijderen van niet-ontplofte munitie.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: In de meest dichtbevolkte stad ter wereld probeert Jonathan inzicht te krijgen in de nieuwe sociale dynamiek van een moderne samenleving.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2
programme.desc: Epic Exploring: Going Local is terug in Japan, in Nikko, waar Cody weer samenkomt met Sherman Mak en samen bezoeken zij een verlaten wrak en attractiepark genaamd Western Village.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1
programme.desc: Jonathan staat voor zijn grootste uitdaging tot nu toe wanneer hij een land betreedt dat nog altijd worstelt met het definiëren en begrijpen van zijn eigen keuken. Door historische onrust en een streng klimaat is Rusland zijn traditionele kook- en eetcultuur grotendeels kwijtgeraakt. Maar het land blaast deze culinaire traditie nieuw leven in. Jonathan reist naar de uithoeken van Rusland om te leren van moderne chefs en oude keukens waarin het belangrijkste werktuig van de Russische keuken te vinden is: de Russische oven. Hij zal hun inzichten ontdekken, hun inspanningen begrijpen en werken met traditionele Russische ingrediënten om te leren wat de keuken vroeger was en waar het vandaag de dag naartoe gaat.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg komt uit Californië en denkt dat hij de Mexicaanse keuken wel kent. Maar die illusie spat uiteen zodra hij de overvloed aan eten in Mexico-Stad ervaart. Terwijl hij schorpioen-taco’s proeft en louche markten in San Juan ontwijkt, leert hij over de mysterieuze wereld van heilige dranken zoals pulque en mezcal, die inmiddels tot sociale genotsmiddelen zijn getransformeerd. Zijn reis voert hem ook naar Oaxaca, waar hij de geheimen van de legendarische molesaus ontdekt. Een lange tocht naar een afgelegen dorp onthult een geheime ceremonie met wortels in de duistere kunsten!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4
programme.desc: Sashi verkent de stranden, octopuscurry en verse zeevruchten van de Seychellen – van Mahé tot het afgelegen Desroches – voor een echte proeverij van het paradijs.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4
programme.desc: In Soneva Jani ervaart Sashi ultraluxe dineren, van krabcurry tot verrassende chef’s tables en BBQ’s bij zonsondergang, in het meest iconische resort van de Malediven.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4
programme.desc: Sashi verkent Mauritius, van streetfood tot luxe resorts, proeft rum, ontmoet topchefs en ontdekt waarom dit eiland uitgroeit tot een nieuwe wereldwijde hotspot.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Ash bevindt zich in de laatste etappe van zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur. Nadat hij de bouwtechnieken van de Muur heeft bestudeerd, trekt hij verder de Gobiwoestijn in, naar het betoverende Crescent Lake – een prachtige oase tussen zandduinen.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1
programme.desc: Na een weerzien met een oude vriend van de Chu-muur bezoekt Ash enkele indrukwekkende stenen structuren – zowel natuurlijke als door mensenhanden gemaakt – in het Yardang Nationaal Park en in Xiaofang City. Met een laatste telefoontje naar huis komt er een einde aan zijn reis langs de Chinese Muur.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Tijdens de Sengoku-periode was Japan het rijk van krijgers: samoerai, ronin en ninja’s. Jonathan duikt het verleden in om de nog altijd springlevende tradities van het Bushido te onthullen.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Een seizoen vol hoogtepunten! Presentator Jonathan Legg blikt terug op zijn beste momenten uit het tweede seizoen van Road Less Traveled, onthult unieke inzichten uit de bestemmingen en deelt nooit eerder vertoond beeldmateriaal.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan begint zijn reis in Californië met een ruige 4x4-doorsteek door de Mojave-woestijn, vol spookstadjes en gevaren. Uiteindelijk maakt hij zijn weg naar Las Vegas, waar een geheel nieuwe reeks avonturen op hem wacht.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2
programme.desc: Een gevaarlijke rit naar Ecuador leidt tot wat rust naast een actieve vulkaan! Hij krijgt een hechte band met een vrouw door hun overeenkomstige passie voor honden.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2
programme.desc: Leon waagt een poging om te zandboarden in de duinen van Peru. In Lima vindt hij een man die zijn passie voor het ontmoeten van medereizigers deelt.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2
programme.desc: Op weg naar Machu Pichu ontmoet Leon een zachtaardige visser. In Urubamba bezoekt hij een vriendin en haar school, wat hem versteld doet staan.

programme.title: Roads End S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering herbeleven Rob en Dave enkele van de hoogtepunten van hun ongelofelijke reis van 6000 km.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4
programme.desc: Sashi duikt in de foodscene van Mauritius, met streetfood, rum, topchefs en luxe resorts, en laat zien waarom dit eiland snel uitgroeit tot een must-visit bestemming.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en zijn team genieten van het wakeboarden in het prachtige Kraalbaai Langebaan, probeert Adam deze ervaring te evenaren.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: De Zuid-Afrikaanse crew bezoekt de Langebergbergen voor een heerlijke dag van ontspanning en ontdekking, terwijl Adam op zoek gaat naar wilde dieren op zijn geïmproviseerde Canadese safari.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1
programme.desc: Terwijl Xander en zijn team de weelderige, groene valleien en ongelooflijke wijngaarden in Robertson bezoeken, leert Adam een harde les over overleven, en tevens gedijen.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan onderzoekt het concept van duurzaam toerisme in Cambodja; hij gaat op een junglepatrouille met Wildlife Alliance en belicht het verhaal van de illegale stroperij- en handelindustrie.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3
programme.desc: Jonathan begint aan een zoektocht naar een extreem type heilige man, van wie wordt gezegd dat hij mensenvlees eet en bewust taboes doorbreekt op een bizarre weg naar nirvana.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning (2023)

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III (2023)
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk (2003)
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

programme.title: Over The Top (1987)
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: Convoy (1978)
programme.desc: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man (1991)
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

programme.title: The Wild Angels (1966)

programme.title: Enter The Ninja (2023)

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja (2023)
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination (2023)
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Mad Max (2023)
programme.desc: In the ravaged near-future, a brutal motorcycle gang rules the road, terrorizing innocent civilians. But they underestimate one cop: Max (Mel Gibson). When the bikers brutalize Max's family, they send him into a mad frenzy and a need for revenge!

programme.title: Mad Max (2023)
programme.desc: In the ravaged near-future, a brutal motorcycle gang rules the road, terrorizing innocent civilians. But they underestimate one cop: Max (Mel Gibson). When the bikers brutalize Max's family, they send him into a mad frenzy and a need for revenge!

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

programme.title: Rollerball (2002)
programme.desc: Chris Klein, LL Cool J, and Rebecca Romijn-Stamos star in this high-octane thriller as the hottest team in the brutal sport Rollerball. When they discover the league's owner (Jean Reno) will do anything for ratings, they plan to take down the sport!

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe (1987)

programme.title: Death Wish II (1982)
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back – with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

programme.title: Death Wish 3 (1985)
programme.desc: A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

programme.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown (1987)
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programme.title: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death (1994)
programme.desc: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

programme.title: Rush (2025)

programme.title: The Hot Spot (1990)
programme.desc: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Flesh + Blood (1985)
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: Pyaar Zindagi Hai
programme.desc: After the marriage of his daughter, Hridaynath lives a simple life with his unmarried daughter in Dehra Dun. His newly married daughter pays them a visit. She finds out that Hridaynath has debts and is in trouble.

programme.title: Desi Boyz
programme.desc: A comedy-drama film about two friends, who lose their jobs during the recession. They decide to become male escorts to make ends meet, hiding their new profession from their families. However, their lives become more complicated when they fall in love and have to deal with the consequences of their new careers. Their lives take a turn when their secret is exposed, leading to a series of comical situations and misunderstandings.

programme.title: Gandhi My Father
programme.desc: The turbulent and troubled life of Gandhi's son, Harilal, who at once tried to support his father's ideology, while simultaneously trying to create a life for himself, separate from his family name.

programme.title: Kitne Door Kitne Paas
programme.desc: After studying in New York City, Jatin (Fardeen Khan) is returning home to India, where he's set to marry a woman from his hometown. On his flight to Delhi, he meets Karishma (Amrita Arora), coincidentally on her way to her own marriage, and her quick temper instantly sets them at odds. Once in Delhi, the unlikely travel companions find their connecting flight has been cancelled, so Jatin and Karishma must share a long bus ride to Gujarat, discovering each other and themselves in the process.

programme.title: Happy Ending
programme.desc: Yudi is suffering from writer's block and his publishers decide to stop supporting him and instead publish the work of an Indian bestselling author. So, he must do something soon to maintain his fame.

programme.title: Ek Thi Daayan
programme.desc: A supernatural thriller that tells the story of a magician haunted by a childhood memory of encountering a witch. When he falls in love with a woman who resembles the witch, he must confront his fears and uncover the truth about her identity. The film explores themes of superstition, fear, and the power of the mind in a spine-tingling and suspenseful plot.

programme.title: Koi Aap Sa
programme.desc: A film that centers around a young man who develops feelings for his childhood friend, who is already in a committed relationship. As he tries to move on, he falls in love with another woman. However, things become complicated when his childhood friend realizes her own feelings for him.

programme.title: R D Burman – Musical Maverick
programme.desc: A powerhouse collection of R.D. Burman's iconic hits, blending innovation, emotion, and energy. From soulful ballads to electrifying grooves, experience the genius of Pancham Da that defined Bollywood's golden soundscape.

programme.title: Best Of 70s – The Golden Era
programme.desc: Step into Bollywood’s most soulful decade with this jukebox of evergreen melodies. A rich tapestry of romance, innocence, and timeless charm – pure nostalgia from the golden 70s.

programme.title: Best Of 90s – Filmy Beats Reloaded
programme.desc: Take a ride through the vibrant 90s with peppy love anthems, dramatic duets, and emotional melodies. This jukebox celebrates the signature style of Bollywood's musical revival decade.

programme.title: Rajesh Khanna – The Superstar's Anthems
programme.desc: Revisit the unmatched charm of Rajesh Khanna with this jukebox of unforgettable melodies. Romantic, philosophical, and heartfelt – these songs defined an era and a superstar.

programme.title: Jeetendra Hits The Jumping Jack
programme.desc: Dive into Jeetendra’s iconic hits—The Jumping Jack’s timeless energy! Relive the magic of Bollywood’s golden era with foot-tapping beats, romance, and pure nostalgia!

programme.title: Neetu Singh Evergreen Hits
programme.desc: Turn up the retro vibes with Neetu Singh’s greatest hits! A birthday playlist packed with nostalgia, romance, and endless charm.

programme.title: Superhits Of 90s
programme.desc: Relive the '90s with Superhits! Romantic melodies, peppy beats, and timeless nostalgia—dance, sing along, and fall in love all over again!

programme.title: Dharmendra He Man Of Bollywood
programme.desc: Time-travel through Dharmendra's iconic hits – the ultimate He-Man of Bollywood! Timeless romance, unforgettable melodies that define an era of pure masala magic!

programme.title: Alka Yagnik Superhit Singer
programme.desc: Press play on nostalgia! Alka Yagnik's velvet voice brings back memories with these evergreen hits that still give us goosebumps today.

programme.title: Dimple Kapadia & Neetu Singh
programme.desc: Dance through the disco era with Dimple & Neetu! Playful whispers, foot-tapping romance, and melodies that defined a generation’s dreams.

programme.title: Mithun Chakraborty
programme.desc: Get ready to groove with Mithun Da's greatest hits! From 'Disco Dancer' to romantic ballads, this collection is pure Bollywood retro gold.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home

programme.title: Direct Talk

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change the World
programme.sub-title: Elephant Encounters: Why Are They Surging?
programme.desc: Wild elephants entering human living areas, causing accidents and crop damage, is a problem across Asia. What will happen to elephant-human coexistence as their habitats shift due to climate change?

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE: Off to go Bathing
programme.desc: A mother and daughter brave the rain to visit their local bathhouse, exchanging words with a young girl along the way. We learn that regular bathing was an essential part of life for the townspeople.

programme.title: Medical Frontiers
programme.desc: A new treatment for irregular heartbeats, pulsed field ablation, or PFA, reduces patient burden and offers high success rates. We also explore a food component that may help prevent the condition.

programme.title: CATCH JAPAN
programme.desc: We feature land-rooted Japanese wine shaped by tradition, a company pursuing innovation through photonics, a journey through history in Hagi City, and a company's commitment to high-quality knives.

programme.title: History Uncovered
programme.desc: Worn by samurai on formal occasions, in-ro were palm-sized containers crafted with masterful skill. In each piece, we uncover the refined spirit of samurai dandyism.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture. This episode looks at words related to castle. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan
programme.desc: Etchu Owara-Kaze-no-Bon is a 300-year-old matsuri held in Yatsuo, Toyama Prefecture. Eleven neighborhoods choose their own routes, dances and parade styles, all of which feature elegant music, dancing and singing. Originally a prayer for bountiful harvests and lasting prosperity, it is a community event in which only local people dance and perform. With the threat of COVID-19 receding, the festival went ahead in 2022 for the first time in three years, to the great delight of Yatsuo residents.

programme.title: Naked Science (2008)
programme.desc: We breathe it every day, it protects us from solar radiation, controls our weather – it’s the atmosphere. Naked Science takes a trip from the earth to near space to understand how the earth’s atmosphere affects all life on the planet.

programme.title: Naked Science (2009)
programme.desc: The Earth hurtles through space protected by an invisible force field, known as a magnetosphere.

programme.title: Naked Science (2009)
programme.desc: Earth has an evil twin. Venus. It is shrouded in a lethal atmosphere of carbon dioxide and acid rain. The surface temperature is hot enough to melt lead and the pressure high enough to crush a nuclear submarine.

programme.title: Naked Science (2009)
programme.desc: Tornados are one of the most destructive forces of the planets with winds at 300 miles an hour. They can destroy buildings and hurl cars hundreds of feet through the air.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers (2015)
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe (2015)
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us ... for the moment.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave (2016)
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side (2016)
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond (2017)
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface (2017)
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier (2018)
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid Sample Return Mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock, ready to dip down to acquire its sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the development of planetary defense systems.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier (2018)
programme.desc: We're looking hard, but the numbers aren't stacking up. Is life on other planets really that hard to find? Does it even exist? We have not discovered so much as a signal, so maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy!

programme.title: Hubble's Canvas (Blue Ant International) (2008)
programme.desc: Hubble was created to dispense with the biggest problem in astronomy, the interference caused by earth’s atmosphere.

programme.title: Hubble's Canvas (Blue Ant International) (2008)
programme.desc: The universe paints pictures with light, so to understand what a Hubble picture can reveal about the universe, it’s necessary to understand how light is emitted, absorbed and reflected by stars, gas and dust.

programme.title: Hubble's Canvas (Blue Ant International) (2008)
programme.desc: Every Hubble image begins in black and white, so why are Hubble’s pictures so colourful? The telescope has a wide range of filters that can be assigned different colours.

programme.title: Hubble's Canvas (Blue Ant International) (2008)
programme.desc: Our ancestors thought the sky was flat, but we now know it as a place of infinite depth.

programme.title: Hubble's Canvas (Blue Ant International) (2008)
programme.desc: The forces of nature, operating at large and small scales create a universe of symmetry and form.

programme.title: Hubble's Canvas (Blue Ant International) (2008)
programme.desc: There are monsters loose in the cosmos, giant black holes that devour matter and spit out high-speed jets of atoms.

programme.title: Volcanoes of the Deep Sea (2003)
programme.desc: Plunge into the ocean 12,000 feet deep for an unprecedented experience of this vast and little-explored dimension of our planet. The film follows a team of scientists as they dive to research mysterious hydrothermal vents on the mid-ocean ridge. | Cast: Ed Harris

programme.title: Voyage of the Continents: Oceania: The Tectonic Ring of Fire (2015)
programme.sub-title: Oceania: The Tectonic Ring of Fire
programme.desc: Australia is now a solid and stable continent surrounded by more volatile neighbors. Pacific and Australian plates clash across the South Pacific causing intense geological and volcanic activity. Travel back in time through deserts, rock and fossils.

programme.title: Voyage of the Continents: Asia: The Tectonics of Life and Death (2015)
programme.sub-title: Asia: The Tectonics of Life and Death
programme.desc: First Asia hurtled into Europe. Then, India crashed violently into the Asian continent. That shock gave birth to the highest mountain range in the world, the Himalayas. But it also released dangerous gases believed to have caused dinosaur extinction...

programme.title: Voyage of the Continents: Asia: Rising Mountains and Sinking Countries (2015)
programme.sub-title: Asia: Rising Mountains and Sinking Countries
programme.desc: Effects from the Indo-Asian collision were felt thousands of kilometers away. The deforming pressure towards the East created Indochina, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Japan. How else could the remains of primitive Asians have been found in Java?

programme.title: Voyage of the Continents: Europe: Tropical Beginnings (2015)
programme.desc: One billion years ago there was just one great continent on earth. It began to break apart and Europe drifted away. Tectonic collisions, tropical vegetation, inland seas and hot lagoons are what temperate contemporary Europe is made of.

programme.title: Voyage of the Continents: Europe: A Turbulent Future (2015)
programme.desc: Over time, the Atlantic Ocean widened. Then Africa moved north, struck Europe and birthed the Alps. Erosion, volcanic activity, and ice ages fashioned an extraordinarily rich and varied continent, ready for the arrival of human beings.

programme.title: Voyage of the Continents: The Origins of Africa (2015)
programme.desc: Africa is Mother Earth. Gondwana, the first, single, landmass broke apart into today's continents, but its heart is Africa. Land of rifts, lakes and volcanoes, Africa's mineral deposits testify to its eons-old history.

programme.title: Voyage of the Continents: Africa Today (2015)
